tasks.title: Build Telegram accounting agent bot (Arabic)
tasks.description: Implement a Telegram bot that converses in Arabic to manage accounting records: store transactions (debit/credit), compute sums, record entries, and retrieve full customer information by name. Include persistence (SQLite), simple commands, and natural language prompts.

comments.content:
## Technical Research

**Summary:** Repo is empty. Implement Node.js Telegram bot with Telegraf, SQLite for persistence, schema: customers, transactions. Commands and NLP-friendly parsing in Arabic. Environment .env for BOT_TOKEN.

**Findings:** No existing code. Telegraf is stable; better-sqlite3 is synchronous and reliable for small bots. Need command routing and free-text intents in Arabic.

**Sources:**
- Local: empty repo
- https://telegraf.js.org/#/?id=telegraf
- https://www.npmjs.com/package/better-sqlite3

**Recommendations:** Use TypeScript, structure as src/, services/, db/. Provide seed and backup. Add basic Arabic NLP via regex and keywords.
comments.author: ai

comments.content:
## Business Research

**Summary:** User needs an Arabic accounting assistant: talks, records transactions, sums totals, retrieves customer info by name.

**Findings:** Core flows: add transaction, list customer, get balances, daily totals. Must be fast and simple.

**Sources:**
- User request

**Recommendations:** Deliver MVP with commands and natural Arabic phrases. Keep data local in SQLite, export CSV.

changes.description: Created SQLite layer: tables customers and transactions, upsert customer, add transaction, summaries, totals, CSV export.
Implemented Telegraf bot: guided Arabic flow for adding transactions, commands /customer, /sum, /export, session-based steps, error handling, and launch.
Added setup and usage guide, features list, commands, and install instructions.
Refactored storage to sql.js (pure JS) with file persistence, async-ready API (ready promise), and helper query functions.
Updated bot to await async DB API (sql.js). Added ready await before launch and awaited all DB operations.
Added BOT_TOKEN guard, debug middleware logging updates, /ping health command, and getMe username log on launch.
Added startup diagnostics: log cwd, whether BOT_TOKEN exists when missing, and masked BOT_TOKEN prefix when loaded.
Added production Dockerfile: installs deps, builds TypeScript, prunes dev deps, and runs dist/index.js on Node 22 Alpine.
Added .dockerignore to exclude node_modules, dist, .env, and Auxly data.
Added Procfile for worker dynos: node dist/index.js.
Documented deployment steps for Render/Railway/Heroku worker using Docker and Procfile.
Added GitHub Actions CI to install and build on Node 22 for main branch.
Added Render worker manifest with build/start commands and BOT_TOKEN env var.
Extended README with Render quick start steps and environment configuration.
Ensured ignores for node_modules/, .env, and dist/ to avoid uploading dependencies and secrets.

question.text: جهّزت ملفات النشر وCI. هل تريد أن أتابع بإعداد نشر Render الآن أم تفضّل Railway/Heroku؟
question.context: موجود Dockerfile، Procfile، render.yaml، وREADME محدّث. نحتاج ربط الريبو مع المنصّة وإضافة BOT_TOKEN كمتغيّر بيئة.

question.text: هل لديك رابط مستودع GitHub جاهز لأضيفه كـ remote؟ أم أسمي لك مستودعًا جديدًا مثلاً telegram-accounting-bot؟
question.context: سأهيئ git محليًا وأقوم بأول commit. نحتاج رابط remote (git@github.com:USER/REPO.git أو https://...). بدون الرابط لا يمكن push.

question.text: أي طريقة تفضّل للمصادقة مع GitHub لدفع الكود؟
